show.description:
Samy and Sarath are childhood friends, but their sons, Kathir and Dev, become rivals at the family restaurant. After Samy leaves and Sarath dies, Dev blames Kathir, while Kathir rises from a small roadside stall with his talent.
When they face each other on the Great Indian Kitchen stage, will jealousy win, or will true talent prove itself?
